newsitem.title: USA: National Steel sees continued robust demand.
newsitem.headline: National Steel sees continued robust demand.

text.p: National Steel Corp said Monday it expects strong earnings and demand for its products to continue into the second quarter.
"We ended the (first) quarter very strong and expect demand for our products to remain robust in the second quarter," said Chairman and Chief Executive Osamu Sawaragi.
The company said first-quarter net was $25.9 million, or $0.53 per share. A year earlier it lost $15.6 million, or $0.42 per share.
Shipments set a first quarter record of 1.52 million net tons, up six percent from a year ago.

"Our operating profit per ton shipped of $28 was our best in nearly two years. Operational stability was a key to our performance and I am very encouraged by the efforts of our employees in achieving these results," said Sawaragi.
